turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I want to make iced coffee at home this summer. Where do I start?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The easiest way is to brew your coffee a bit stronger than usual and pour it over lots of ice, so it doesn't get watery.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can I ask about something else? I need to cut down to one streaming service. Money's tight this month.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Totally understandable. For films, do you care more about a huge back catalogue of older stuff, or getting the new releases quickly?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It's either Tuesday or— right, ten seconds, Moshi, then ask me again.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay, which matters more for the one service you keep?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: New releases. My kids would riot otherwise.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Fair enough. Cancel the others now and set a reminder to check again in a few months.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: What about cold brew? Is that hard?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: It's really easy, just slow. Mix coarse coffee with cold water, leave it in the fridge overnight, and strain it in the morning.
